**Important Notices**

**URGENT MEDICAL DEVICE REMOVAL: Accu-Chek Guide Meters**

Important information on Accu-Chek Guide meters: Nine Accu-ChekGuide meters were configured
incorrectly, and thus show the results in mmol/L rather than in the labeled measuring unit, mg/dL.
Please check your meter to see if the display shows the appropriate measuring unit (mg/dL) and
compare the serial number of your meter with the listed affected serial numbers to determine if it
is impacted by this issue: 92339920445, 92339955415, 92340116052, 92340117408, 92340120006,
92340120057, 92339920116, 92339094787 & 92339744998. If your serial number is listed, discontinue
use of the meter and follow instructions in the file linked below.

**URGENT MEDICAL DEVICE REMOVAL: Accu-Chek Guide Meters**

Important information on Accu-Chek Guide meters: Nine Accu-ChekGuide meters were configured
incorrectly, and thus show the results in mmol/L rather than in the labeled measuring unit, mg/dL.
Please check your meter to see if the display shows the appropriate measuring unit (mg/dL) and
compare the serial number of your meter with the listed affected serial numbers to determine if it
is impacted by this issue: 92339920445, 92339955415, 92340116052, 92340117408, 92340120006,
92340120057, 92339920116, 92339094787 & 92339744998. If your serial number is listed, discontinue
use of the meter and follow instructions in the file linked below.

## Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world

Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]

## Home Test

[Learn More][25]
[[ACON - Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world]][26]

## Making Point-of-care testing affordable around the world

Our product lines include Point of Care, Immunoassays, Molecular Diagnostics and Animal Health.

These products are used in hospitals, clinical laboratories, physician offices, blood banks,
pharmacies and veterinary clinics.

[ACON's Story][27]

### Our Brands

#### Blood Glucose Meter Systems

Carefully designed for accuracy and reliability, the *On Call*^{®} Blood Glucose Meter Family has
helped millions of patients worldwide effectively manage their glucose levels.

[View Product Line][28]
[Mission POCT]

#### Point-of-care testing (POCT)

Our product offering includes a variety of urine reagent test strips, urine analyzers and handheld
devices for the measurement of cholesterol, coagulation and hemoglobin. 

[View Product Line][29]
[HealthyMe Logo]

#### Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)

ACON Labs has been the leading UTI manufacturer in the US. The HealthyMe Urinary Tract Infection
reagent strips are highly reliable and easy to use.

[View Product][30]
[ACON Laboratories, Inc]

#### Lateral Flow Rapid Tests

Reliable qualitative screening for Pregnancy, Cancer Markers and Infectious Disease including our
SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) antibody test.

[View Product Line][31]
[Mission POCT]

#### Our Newest Brand

Flowflex^{TM} is the newest brand addition to the ACON product portfolio.  The Flowflex SARS-CoV-2
Rapid Antigen Test is the first in this family of lateral flow testing products.

[View Product][32]
[Mission POCT]

#### Pregnancy Rapid Tests

Rapid chromatographic immunoassays for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin
(hCG) in urine. 

[View Product Line][33]
[Mission POCT]

#### Allergen Test Kit

This tried-and-true immunoblot assay tests for 30 allergens on one strip.

[View Product Line][34]

#### Molecular Diagnostics

Nucleic Acid Extraction System and PCR quantitative test kits for HBV, HCV, HPV 16/18, HPV
Genotyping, TB and HLA-B27.

[View Product Line][35]
[CentriVet Logo]

#### Animal Health

Our product offering includes a dual Ketone/Glucose meter, as well as urine reagent test strips.

[View Product Line][36]
[[ACON San Diego]][37]

## Relentless innovation from the leaders in glucose health 

Dexcom has set the standard in glucose biosensing for 25 years and counting. Our best-in-class
technologies empower people to know what is happening in their bodies in real time, helping them to
better understand the many factors that impact their glucose and overall health.
Smart devices sold separately.^{‡}
* [Explore our portfolio][5]
[two people smiling in the park one wearing the Dexcom G7 sensor]
[Dexcom G7 sensor]

## Dexcom G7 and Dexcom G7 15 Day—the world's most powerful CGM systems²

Dexcom G7 CGM Systems deliver proven results^{3-7} with best-in-class accuracy² and a growing
ecosystem of connected partners that help ease the burden of living with diabetes. They’re designed
for all types of diabetes, sending glucose numbers to your phone^{*} or receiver in real time,
giving you the knowledge to better control diabetes for healthier tomorrows.^{8,9}
* [Explore Dexcom G7][6]
[Man walking outside while wearing Stelo sensor]
[Stelo sensor]

## Stelo Glucose Biosensor

Get 24/7 insights into how food, exercise, stress, and sleep affect your body, so you can build
habits that power lasting health.^{10,11}
No prescription. FSA/HSA eligible.
* [Learn more][7]
[Woman walking with a friend outside while wearing sensor]

## Empowering people to take control of health 

Since 1999, Dexcom has been developing innovative technology that has transformed how people manage
diabetes and track their glucose. We think of ourselves as partners in their journey, empowering
them to live confidently and take control of their health with our life-changing products.
* [More about Dexcom][8]


### Get Started with Dexcom

Take the first step towards better health! Glucose health is a critical part of overall health, and
Dexcom has the best sensing solution for you or your loved one regardless of your health goals.
We'll make getting started easy from the comfort of your home.

diabetes. We pioneer patient-centric digital solutions and technologies and believe partnerships
that foster cooperation and creativity are vital to improving healthcare.

## A commitment to accessible diabetes care for all

Serving patients across the United States with Medicare, Medicaid, and 500+ Medicare advantage and
commercial plans.

[Get Started][28]

## Getting Started is Simple.

### You take the first step. We handle the rest.

Submit your information, select your CGM and support, and call your doctor. We handle the paperwork
and approvals and deliver your CGM supplies and support directly to your home.

[How It Works][29]

## CGMs & Supplies Through Insurance

Tired of finger sticks? A continuous glucose monitor (CGM) gives real-time insights into your
glucose levels, helping you manage diabetes with more confidence. At Aeroflow Diabetes, we navigate
your insurance and handle the paperwork—often getting you a CGM at little to no cost.

[Covered Products][30]

## Sync your diabetes care with your CGM

Living with diabetes shouldn't be a constant battle with finger pricks, insurance calls, and
pharmacy pickups. Aeroflow Diabetes is here to simplify the process, ensuring you get the supplies
and support you need directly through your insurance provider.

[Learn More][31]

## Trusted by Leading Voices

## The Aeroflow Difference

### CONNECT

###### with Aeroflow Diabetes for a CGM covered by insurance.

From insurance approval to doorstep delivery, we handle the details so you can focus on what matters
— your health.

[Learn More][32]

### SYNC

###### your data with the Welldoc® App.

Managing diabetes is easier when you have the right tools in place. The Welldoc® App for Aeroflow
Diabetes patients wraps all your data into one easy-to-use app.

[Learn More][33]

### SUPPORT

###### your journey with education and coaching.

Join a vibrant community of patients, diabetes specialists, and nutritionists focused on removing
barriers to diabetes management.

[Learn More][34]

## Check your coverage in less than 2 minutes.

[Fill Out Form][35]

## Why You'll Love Working With Aeroflow Diabetes

## Understand Your Coverage & Support

#### CGMs and Insurance Coverage: What to Know

Medicare and most major private health insurance plans now offer some level of coverage and
reimbursement for CGMs when prescribed by an endocrinologist or healthcare provider.

[Read More][36]

#### Glucose Monitoring Without Finger Pricks With CGMs

CGMs provide more frequent, real-time glucose data, which can help improve diabetes management
decisions and overall health outcomes.

[Read More][37]

#### Is the FreeStyle Libre 3 System Covered by Medicare?

With Medicare and Aeroflow Diabetes, you may qualify for coverage of the FreeStyle Libre 3 System,
making it more affordable and accessible for diabetes patients.

[Read More][38]

#### Dexcom G7: What's New & How to Get It Through Insurance

The Dexcom G7 offers a smaller, sleeker design, faster 30-minute sensor warm-up, and an integrated
transmitter-sensor system for easier use.

[Read More][39]

[Dr. Shwachman uses the sweat test box he invented to diagnose cystic fibrosis]

### The history of cystic fibrosis diagnosis

In 1955, Dr. Harry Shwachman, head of Boston Children’s Cystic Fibrosis Clinic, developed the first
practical sweat test to diagnose cystic fibrosis (CF). It involved encasing the patient’s body in a
plastic bag to collect sweat, then using the pictured device to measure levels of salt in the
sample. Cystic fibrosis causes sweat to be 2-5 times saltier than average. The sweat test allowed
for much simpler and earlier diagnosis of CF, crucial to effective treatment. A version of it is
still the main diagnostic tool used today.

 

Learn more about [Boston Children’s Archives Program.][103]

[Dr. Shwachman uses the sweat test box he invented to diagnose cystic fibrosis]

### The history of cystic fibrosis diagnosis

In 1955, Dr. Harry Shwachman, head of Boston Children’s Cystic Fibrosis Clinic, developed the first
practical sweat test to diagnose cystic fibrosis (CF). It involved encasing the patient’s body in a
plastic bag to collect sweat, then using the pictured device to measure levels of salt in the
sample. Cystic fibrosis causes sweat to be 2-5 times saltier than average. The sweat test allowed
for much simpler and earlier diagnosis of CF, crucial to effective treatment. A version of it is
still the main diagnostic tool used today.

 

Learn more about [Boston Children’s Archives Program.][103]

## What is keto?

Keto is not just a diet, it’s a way of life.
It is based on a decisive reduction of carbohydrates, the consumption of moderate amounts of protein
and a significant increase in the intake of healthy fats, such as MCTs.

**In every way, it improves the quality of your life.
**
From boosting physical endurance to improving brain function, keto increases energy levels and makes
you the best version of yourself, and BeKeto is here to help.

It is based on a decisive reduction of carbohydrates, the consumption of moderate amounts of protein
and a significant increase in the intake of healthy fats, such as MCTs.

# Clang: a C language family frontend for LLVM

The Clang project provides a language front-end and tooling infrastructure for languages in the C
language family (C, C++, Objective C/C++, OpenCL, and CUDA) for the [LLVM][26] project. Both a
GCC-compatible compiler driver (clang) and an MSVC-compatible compiler driver (clang-cl.exe) are
provided. You can [get and build][27] the source today.

## Features and Goals

Some of the goals for the project include the following:

**[End-User Features][28]**:
* Fast compiles and low memory use
* Expressive diagnostics ([examples][29])
* GCC & MSVC compatibility

**[Utility and Applications][30]**:
* Modular library based architecture
* Support diverse clients (refactoring, static analysis, code generation, etc.)
* Allow tight integration with IDEs
* Use the LLVM 'Apache 2' [License][31]

**[Internal Design and Implementation][32]**:
* A real-world, production quality compiler
* A simple and hackable code base
* A single unified parser for C, Objective C, C++, and Objective C++
* Conformance with C/C++/ObjC and their variants

Of course this is only a rough outline of the goals and features of Clang. To get a true sense of
what it is all about, see the [Features][33] section, which breaks each of these down and explains
them in more detail.

## Why?

Development of the new front-end was started out of a need for a compiler that allows better
diagnostics, better integration with IDEs, a license that is compatible with commercial products,
and a nimble compiler that is easy to develop and maintain. All of these were motivations for
starting work on a new front-end that could meet these needs.

## Current Status

Clang is considered to be a production quality C, Objective-C, C++ and Objective-C++ compiler when
targeting any target supported by LLVM. As example, Clang is used in production to build
performance-critical software like Chrome or Firefox.
If you are looking for source analysis or source-to-source transformation tools, Clang is probably a
great solution for you. Please see the [C++ status][34] page or the [C status][35] page for more
information about what standard modes and features are supported.

## Get it and get involved!

Start by [getting the code, building it, and playing with it][36]. This will show you the sorts of
things we can do today and will let you have the "Clang experience" first hand: hopefully it will
"resonate" with you. :)

Once you've done that, please consider [getting involved in the Clang community][37]. The Clang
developers include numerous volunteer contributors with a variety of backgrounds. If you're
interested in following the development of Clang, signing up for a mailing list is a good way to
learn about how the project works.

# Clang: a C language family frontend for LLVM

The Clang project provides a language front-end and tooling infrastructure for languages in the C
language family (C, C++, Objective C/C++, OpenCL, and CUDA) for the [LLVM][26] project. Both a
GCC-compatible compiler driver (clang) and an MSVC-compatible compiler driver (clang-cl.exe) are
provided. You can [get and build][27] the source today.

## Features and Goals

Some of the goals for the project include the following:

**[End-User Features][28]**:
* Fast compiles and low memory use
* Expressive diagnostics ([examples][29])
* GCC & MSVC compatibility

**[Utility and Applications][30]**:
* Modular library based architecture
* Support diverse clients (refactoring, static analysis, code generation, etc.)
* Allow tight integration with IDEs
* Use the LLVM 'Apache 2' [License][31]

**[Internal Design and Implementation][32]**:
* A real-world, production quality compiler
* A simple and hackable code base
* A single unified parser for C, Objective C, C++, and Objective C++
* Conformance with C/C++/ObjC and their variants

Of course this is only a rough outline of the goals and features of Clang. To get a true sense of
what it is all about, see the [Features][33] section, which breaks each of these down and explains
them in more detail.

## Why?

Development of the new front-end was started out of a need for a compiler that allows better
diagnostics, better integration with IDEs, a license that is compatible with commercial products,
and a nimble compiler that is easy to develop and maintain. All of these were motivations for
starting work on a new front-end that could meet these needs.

## Current Status

Clang is considered to be a production quality C, Objective-C, C++ and Objective-C++ compiler when
targeting any target supported by LLVM. As example, Clang is used in production to build
performance-critical software like Chrome or Firefox.
If you are looking for source analysis or source-to-source transformation tools, Clang is probably a
great solution for you. Please see the [C++ status][34] page or the [C status][35] page for more
information about what standard modes and features are supported.

## Get it and get involved!

Start by [getting the code, building it, and playing with it][36]. This will show you the sorts of
things we can do today and will let you have the "Clang experience" first hand: hopefully it will
"resonate" with you. :)

Once you've done that, please consider [getting involved in the Clang community][37]. The Clang
developers include numerous volunteer contributors with a variety of backgrounds. If you're
interested in following the development of Clang, signing up for a mailing list is a good way to
learn about how the project works.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find quick answers to common questions about our services and offerings.

### In what formats can I download the ordered reports?

Reports are available in Microsoft Word, PDF, and PowerPoint formats for user convenience.

### How do I get the receipt of my purchases?

A detailed invoice is automatically sent to your registered email after successful payment

### What do single user, multi-user and enterprise license mean?
* **Single User License:** Access for one individual.
* **Multi-User License:** Access for a few users within the same organization.
* **Enterprise License:** Unlimited access across the entire organization.

### Are samples available for all studies?

Yes, sample reports are available on request to help you assess the report’s quality and structure.

### Can I purchase individual sections of a report?

Yes, individual report sections can be purchased. Please contact our sales team for details.

### How does Decisions Advisors ensure data accuracy?

We use expert validation, triangulation, and multi-step quality checks to ensure data accuracy and

# Advocacy for People Living with Diabetes

Diabetes is the most expensive chronic condition in the U.S. and affects millions of families. This
Chronic Disease Awareness Month, help us continue advocating for people living with diabetes.

## It All Matters

We’ve learned in our 85 years that in the fight to end diabetes, everything matters. So this month,
we’re recognizing all those getting up alongside us and staying in the fight to end diabetes.

Stay on top of what's new at the American Diabetes Association, diabetes-related updates, healthy
living resources, and more!

advocacy

1 in 6 Americans ration insulin due to cost. Support the Insulin Act, critical, bipartisan
legislation that will make insulin more affordable and accessible for millions.

Understanding your risk and taking early action are key steps for diabetes prevention. Explore
expert-backed tools and programs to help you lower your risk for type 2 diabetes.

A podcast for people with diabetes and their caregivers, listen in for practical advice on

Get tools to help with diabetes and kidney-friendly meal planning.

## Diabetes By-the-Numbers

The numbers are staggering. Diabetes isn't just a disease—it's an epidemic, affecting over 40
million Americans with devastating consequences.

1.5M

Americans are diagnosed each year

12%

of Americans had diabetes in 2023

115+M

American adults are living with prediabetes

But there's hope. Join us as we continue the fight to end diabetes and work to find a cure.

## Some Frequently Asked Questions

What Is Considered High Blood Sugar?
* **Fasting blood sugar** (no food for at least 8 hours): **126 mg/dL (7.0 mmol/L)** or higher.
* **Two hours after eating**: **200 mg/dL (11.1 mmol/L)** or higher.
* **Random blood sugar test** (taken at any time): **200 mg/dL (11.1 mmol/L)** or higher,
  particularly if accompanied by symptoms of diabetes such as increased thirst, frequent urination,
  fatigue, or blurred vision.
Can Diabetes Be Reversed?

Type 1 diabetes is generally not considered reversible because it involves an autoimmune response
that destroys insulin-producing beta cells in the pancreas. However, management is possible through:
1. **Insulin Therapy**: Lifelong insulin therapy is necessary.
2. **Diet and Exercise**: These help manage blood sugar levels and improve overall health.
3. **Technological Advances**: Continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) and insulin pumps have improved
   the quality of life for people with type 1 diabetes.
4. **Research**: Ongoing research into beta cell transplantation and immunotherapy holds some
   promise for future treatments.

What Are The Advantages Of a Low GI Diet for Diabetics?

A Low Glycemic Index (Low GI) diet can offer several advantages for diabetics, helping to manage
blood glucose levels more effectively. Here are some key benefits:

1. Better Blood Sugar Control

2. Improved Insulin Sensitivity

3. Weight Management

4. Cardiovascular Health

5. Long-Term Health Benefits

6. Nutrient-Dense Food Choices

## Know what's happening in real time

Distill continuously monitors news coverage, press releases, company blogs, and LinkedIn posts — so
you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Only see the updates worth your attention

Distill filters out duplicate coverage, low-signal updates, and irrelevant noise, helping you
quickly spot the developments that actually matter.

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

[Start for free ][6]

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

## ABOUT FORWARD PATHWAY

Forward Pathway LLC is an educational consultant company established in US and dedicated to
international students’ application and transfer to US high schools and colleges. Founded in
Pennsylvania, the state rich in educational resources, Forward Pathway takes advantage of nearby
renowned universities as [University of Pennsylvania][20], [Carnegie Mellon
University][21], [University of Pittsburgh][22], [Pennsylvania State University][23] and plenty of
top US colleges in neighboring states. Now its headquarter has moved to Los Angeles. Based in LA to
serve the entire nation, relying on strong partnerships with local US universities, Forward Pathway
is aimed at being students’ personal education specialist, at the first time to update the latest
news of studying abroad.

We provide integrated services for high school and university applications, including personal

application specialists will design plans catering to the student’s own characteristics and goals,
prepare applying materials accordingly and continue to offer follow-up services after the admission

### [US Colleges Database][24]

Forward Pathway is the first company to consolidate and visualize U.S. colleges data, the database
includes general information, [colleges ranking][25], admission, scores requirement, tuition and
fees, students, degrees, campus safety information and so on. By our colleges database tools,
students can easily filter out schools that best suits them.

### Summer/Winter Camps

The camps last 2-3 weeks long when the students will take classes in US public and private high
schools to experience different teaching styles and strengthen their knowledge about American
cultural and academic environment.The programs not only include learning in classrooms, but also
have lots of extra-curricular activities including sports and touring, a unique opportunity for
international students to feel the difference of American educational.

### Emergency Transfer

As the signature service of Forward Pathway, emergency transfer services have been carried out
efficiently on account of FP’s partnership with US local schools once the student was faced with
emergency situations such as probation, suspension or dismissal. The team will respond quickly to
make emergency plans and ensure the students transferring to new school within one to three weeks
with legal student status.

## COMPANY PHILOSOPHY

Forward Pathway, by the meaning of its name, aims at offering guidance and recommendations for
international students who are willing to study abroad in US, solving problems for the current
international students in US to carry on their academic path, and providing opportunities for
potential students to further their understanding of American education through communication
programs in the local schools.

Running in the belief of student benefits and customer satisfaction in the first place, and with all
team members familiar with application process in US, Forward Pathway relies on the abundant
educational resources in partnership with local institutions to obtain the most updated and
comprehensive information in studying in US, in order to ensure that every customer receive
high-quality services.

Forward Pathway is certified by American International Recruitment Council (AIRC), comments about
Forward Pathway for AIRC please click this [link][26].

Ketogenic diet is a low carb, moderate protein, and high fat diet which puts the body into a
metabolic state known as ketosis. It dates back to the early 1900s when it was discovered for
controlling seizures.

Today, many people choose the keto diet for weight loss, improved neurological functioning,
increased mental clarity, and sustained all-day energy.

How does it work?

With the average person’s diet, glucose is the main energy source. When you eat, let’s say a muffin,
your body will produce glucose. Glucose is the easiest molecule for your body to convert and use as
energy and that is why it’s the preferred energy source for your body.

Again, in an average person, the extra glucose gets converted into fat which is then stored, thanks
to release of Insulin. Insulin is a fat storage hormone. With more circulating insulin in your
bloodstream, your body converts the carbohydrates to fat and stores them — on your buttocks, thighs,
abdomen and hips.

Sugar-Burners vs. Fat-Burners

“Sugar-burners” are people who eat a lot of carbohydrates. They burn carbs for energy and need a
steady supply of carbs to keep their energy up. Always relying on carbs for energy, they have
difficulty accessing and burning their stored fat.

When we eat less carbs, we become “fat-burners.” The body first goes for carbs to burn for fuel, but
after it burns the small amount of carbohydrates eaten, primarily from vegetables, it then accesses
and burns stored body fat, which leads to weight loss

What is Ketosis?

When you lower your consumption of refined carbohydrates, your blood glucose level and insulin level
drops. And the body begins to look for an alternative energy source and your body enters a metabolic
state known as ketosis. You can also enter ketosis state by not eating anything for a period of
time, fasting.

When in ketosis, your body will start to produce ketones from stored fat to make up for the lack of
sugar/carbohydrate energy.

This allows the fat cells to release the water they are storing (it’s why you first see a drop in

A ketogenic diet can also change the water and mineral balance of your body, so adding extra salt to

**Weight loss:**

The brain loves ketones. Outside of epilepsy, a keto diet supports other neurological conditions,

Researchers are studying keto as an adjunctive treatment for cancer. So far, results are promising.

Again, in an average person, the extra glucose gets converted into fat which is then stored, thanks

When you lower your consumption of refined carbohydrates, your blood glucose level and insulin level

When we eat less carbs, we become “fat-burners.” The body first goes for carbs to burn for fuel, but

Side Effects and How to Minimize Them

your body adapts. This is often referred to as the keto flu and is usually over within a few days.
Keto flu includes poor energy and mental function, increased hunger, sleep issues, nausea, digestive
discomfort and decreased exercise performance.

To minimize this, you can try a regular low-carb diet for the first few weeks. This may teach your
body to burn more fat before you completely eliminate carbs.

A ketogenic diet can also change the water and mineral balance of your body, so adding extra salt to
your meals or taking mineral supplements can help.

Ketogenic Diet Benefits

**Weight loss:**

Probably the number one reason why people switch to KD is for the weight loss. When you lower your
consumption of carbohydrates, your body burns fat as fuel which keeps you stable and satiated
throughout the day. If you stay within your daily recommended macros (calories broken down into
percentages of fat, protein, and carbs), you can also burn excess fat and lose weight fast.

**Brain Health:**

The brain loves ketones. Outside of epilepsy, a keto diet supports other neurological conditions,
such as Alzheimer’s andParkinson’s. Keto also helps with concentration, memory, focus, cognition,
and decreased brain fog.

**Cancer:**

Researchers are studying keto as an adjunctive treatment for cancer. So far, results are promising.
In recent research, keto significantly increased survival time and slowed tumor growth. Tumor types
were pancreatic, prostate, gastric, colon, brain, neuroblastoma and lung cancers.

## Where Medicine, Technology and Industry Come Together

MEDICA brings together international stakeholders from medicine, technology, industry, and
policymaking. The focus is on integrated solutions that address the challenges of modern healthcare
systems, as well as the exchange of knowledge on their practical implementation. Through curated
formats, clearly defined thematic focus areas, and a high-level conference program, MEDICA provides
exhibitors and visitors with a platform for orientation, networking, and insights into the
developments shaping the future of healthcare.

## A Platform for Tomorrow’s Healthcare

## Where Medicine, Technology and Industry Come Together

MEDICA brings together international stakeholders from medicine, technology, industry, and
policymaking. The focus is on integrated solutions that address the challenges of modern healthcare
systems, as well as the exchange of knowledge on their practical implementation. Through curated
formats, clearly defined thematic focus areas, and a high-level conference program, MEDICA provides
exhibitors and visitors with a platform for orientation, networking, and insights into the
developments shaping the future of healthcare.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

healthcare in India and care for every patient’s life through sustainable, innovative solutions”.

Read more

## Frequently asked questions

What is Slideshare?

Slideshare is the presentation-sharing platform for anyone looking for slide inspiration, to
showcase their knowledge, or to build on their own ideas. With over 25M+ presentations and 70M+
active users, Slideshare is the place where big ideas live.

Why does Slideshare look different?

Slideshare is stepping into a bold new chapter with a refreshed identity. While the core of what you
love remains the same — access to over 25 million decks, powerful AI tools, and a global network of
70+ million curious minds — Slideshare now carries a cleaner, sharper look. This rebrand emphasizes
our renewed mission: helping people transform their ideas into opportunities. With this fresh
energy, Slideshare continues to be the trusted home for expert insights and standout presentations.
This update is just the beginning, designed to better serve creators and thinkers like you.

Do I need a subscription to access Slideshare?

No subscription is required to access Slideshare — you can still browse, read, and upload content.
However, a subscription gives you additional benefits such as the ability to download presentations
and enjoy an ad-free browsing experience.

What is included in a Slideshare subscription?

A paid subscription includes the following exclusive benefits:
* Download presentations
* Copy and paste text directly from presentations
* Enjoy an ad-free experience
* Complimentary access to millions of documents on Scribd

How do I cancel my subscription?

You can cancel your subscription anytime by visiting your account settings. If you cancel, you'll
continue to have access to your subscription benefits until the remaining time expires.

## Formulary

The Devon Formulary promotes safe, effective, and economic prescribing across primary and secondary
care in Devon.

It provides clinical guidance on the management of a wide variety of common conditions, including
locally recommended drug choices presented in a recognisable traffic light classification.

The Devon Formulary is not a restrictive list, but a recommendation drawn up after widespread
consultation with local prescribers and in collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University
Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital),
Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon
Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

##### Drugs A-Z

Browse drug names by A to Z (generically) with hyperlinks to drug entries.

Drug entries describe the medicinal forms, indications, doses, indicative prices, safety updates,
preferred brands where noted, and other considerations involved in the use of a drug included in the
Devon Formulary.

##### Treatment Summaries

The Devon Formulary uses a therapeutic classification system based on and closely following the BNF.

Additional chapters, sections, and paragraphs have been created to include appliances/ preparations,

##### Shared Care Guidelines

Formal Shared Care agreements which enable continued prescribing and monitoring of specialist

## Referral

The Devon Clinical Referral Guidelines (CRGs) are designed to improve the consistency of clinical
care delivered across Devon by promoting locally agreed clinical advice, pathways of care, and
resources for individual clinical conditions.

The Devon Referral content has been developed in collaboration with local clinicians and in
collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal
Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital), Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation
Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

This information has been provided to minimise Emergency Department (ED) referrals.

[Find out more][41]

## Formulary

The Devon Formulary promotes safe, effective, and economic prescribing across primary and secondary
care in Devon.

It provides clinical guidance on the management of a wide variety of common conditions, including
locally recommended drug choices presented in a recognisable traffic light classification.

The Devon Formulary is not a restrictive list, but a recommendation drawn up after widespread
consultation with local prescribers and in collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University
Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital),
Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon
Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

##### Drugs A-Z

Browse drug names by A to Z (generically) with hyperlinks to drug entries.

Drug entries describe the medicinal forms, indications, doses, indicative prices, safety updates,
preferred brands where noted, and other considerations involved in the use of a drug included in the

# Preventive point-of-Care diagnostic systems for professional and personal use

Swiss Point of Care supports structured preventive screening across European markets, providing
medical grade point of care systems for individuals, pharmacies, and occupational health programs.

[ Explore health topics ][108]
[ Buy now ][109]
CE-marked systems | Regulatory-aligned | Designed for responsible use

## Structured screening. Early insight.
## responsible follow-Up.

Preventive screening focuses on early measurement of key health markers before symptoms develop.

Point-of-care systems make structured screening possible locally and efficiently, whether in a
pharmacy, occupational health setting, or through responsible self-monitoring.

Screening does not replace medical diagnosis.

It provides structured insight that supports informed decisions and appropriate follow-up over time.

## Screening systems across
## Key health domains

Swiss Point of Care provides structured screening systems including devices, consumables, and
documentation.

### Metabolic & Cardiovascular Screening

Cholesterol, glucose, ketones, and hemoglobin monitoring systems designed for structured metabolic
and cardiovascular screening.

[ Explore Metabolic & Cardiovascular Screening ][110]

### Preventive Risk
### Screening

Iron status, liver markers, prostate health, menopause, pregnancy and additional preventive
screening applications.


[ Explore Preventive Screening Systems ][111]

### Infection & Inflammation Monitoring

CRP and other rapid markers supporting structured infection and inflammation screening.

[ Explore Infection & Inflammation Screening ][112]

*Availability may vary by market and regulatory status.*

[ Buy now ][113]

## Supporting screening in practice

Swiss Point of Care supports:
* Pharmacy-based screening services
* Occupational health programs (PMO)
* Preventive pilot initiatives
* Individual structured monitoring

Our approach combines medical grade devices with documentation, workflow clarity, and scalable
supply, enabling responsible and repeatable screening.

[ Learn About Professional Implementation ][114]

## Structured monitoring for individuals

Individuals can access the same medical-grade point-of-care systems used in professional
environments.

Clear documentation, health topic guidance, and structured measurement support responsible
self-monitoring.
